purpose: Prove that a fresh GitHub pull_request action=ready_for_review for this exact H1 PR reaches the Work H1 researcher and permits a single GitHub-only CLAIM_BLOCK and TERMINAL RECEIPT. No market/data/strategy activity, no executor or network job.
task_steps: Verify exact event action and originating PR identity, and immutable GitHub task contract; fail closed otherwise with no mutation.
Read canonical H1 Work trigger/project instructions and verify current main context. Do not search for other READY tasks.
When valid and unclaimed, publish exactly one CLAIM_BLOCK as an originating PR comment.
Perform no code execution or further repository writes. Revalidate current main and task identity.

Publish exactly one TERMINAL RECEIPT — with task id, worker id, H1_WORK_READY_TRIGGER_SMOKE_PASS, original PR_HEAD_SHA, actual claim comment ID, CONTINUATION_REVIEW_REQUIRED: true, STRATEGY_REVIEW_REQUIRED: false.
Stop. No follow-on work; Strategy Control must classify this synthetic task as TERMINAL_IDLE_JUSTIFIED, not dispatch another task.
allowed_pr_comment_writes: one CLAIM_BLOCK after exact event validation
forbidden_actions: Test Executor and Research Runner jobs
market/archive body or protected evidence access
creating/editing any file or commit by worker
claiming a different task, polling for replacement READY work
any actual historical H1 self-test or T1 acquisition
rescue, retry or repeated trigger attempts by worker
terminal_rule: On valid event claim then one terminal. If no exact valid GitHub event identity supplied, STOP silently with no claim/terminal/writes. If validation after a valid event fails and exact task permits BLOCKED receipt, use exactly one bounded receipt. No successor automatically from this smoke.
